courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 水壩地震動力分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「測深網格與挖方」與「沉澱面積與表面負荷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水壩地震動力分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume" and "Settling area and surface loading" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic dynamic analysis of dams must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程；水壩地震動力分析則以從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management; Seismic dynamic analysis of dams centres on identify dam-dynamics assumptions through modal mass, forcing histories and model boundaries, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「測深網格與挖方」與「模態質量與週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水壩地震動力分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「附加水質量與週期」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” and “Modal mass and period”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic dynamic analysis of dams, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Added water mass and period", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 水力模型縮尺試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「測深網格與挖方」與「沉澱面積與表面負荷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水力模型縮尺試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume" and "Settling area and surface loading" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程；水力模型縮尺試驗則以用相似律與量測證據分辨水工縮尺模型可代表哪些現象為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management; Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures centres on use similitude and measurement evidence to define what hydraulic scale models represent, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「測深網格與挖方」與「幾何比例與控制長度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水力模型縮尺試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雷諾數與黏滯失真」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” and “Geometry ratio and reference length”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Reynolds number and viscous distortion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水庫抽泥疏浚
history.text: 本課所研究的串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。以指定泥漿均質近似與乾質量帳示意，實際泵送、沉降及環境限制需現地試驗。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Specified homogeneous-slurry and dry-mass examples illustrate bookkeeping; pumping settling and environmental limits require field testing. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.textEn: The course turns "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume" through "Resurveyed capacity and net benefit" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
